PlayStation 4 is Sony's fourth home video game console, part of the eighth generation of consoles.
First released in November 2013 and discontinued in 2024.
Made by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
It launched at $399.99 in the US.
About 117.2 million units were sold.
It followed the PlayStation 3 and was succeeded by the PlayStation 5.
Processors include the PlayStation 4 APU.
